description: Web-based design and prototyping platform meant for cross-domain teams.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-11: a real install of Penpot 2.17.2 — upstream's current release — proved all five containers start, it opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from Penpot's official Compose file because Runtipi's runs :latest images with its exporter pointed at the wrong port. The first qualification failed with the database marked unhealthy: a first start on a host folder took 19 seconds against a 12-second health window, so the start period was lengthened.

risk_notes: Creates 5 Docker containers and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 2 credentials of its own, keeps them beside the app's data, and reuses them if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Anyone who can reach the address can create an account, and there is no mail server, so nothing is ever emailed: a forgotten password cannot be reset from the app. The first account you create is yours; keep its password somewhere safe.
Its exporter runs a headless browser to render exports, and the five containers together use around 1.5 GB of memory while running.
Written by Local Store from Penpot's official Compose file, not taken from an app store. Penpot's MCP server for AI agents is not included, because Local Store publishes one port per app.

  "categories": [
    "Design"

      "max": 32,
      "env_variable": "PENPOT_DB_PASSWORD"
    }
  ]
